The note does not support E11.22. ICD-10-CM presumes a link between diabetes and CKD (the "with" convention), but only when the provider has not documented a different cause. Here the HPI says nephrology attributes the kidney disease to long-standing hypertension rather than diabetes. That is an explicit alternative etiology, so the presumption does not apply.

The note does support separate codes: E11.9 or E11.65 for the diabetes, and I12.9 with N18.31 for hypertensive CKD stage 3a. The albuminuria is not linked to diabetes either. E11.22 is therefore not supported.
